51ff0e6406.why: The four independently addressed stores, source load, and four required scalar updates each need their own instruction at SSE4.1.

cabb510768.rewrite:
movaps xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [CONST_1]
imul rdx,rdx,0xfffffffffffffffc
sub rsi,rdx
sub rdi,rdx
cabb510768.why: Multiplication by -4 combines the shift and negation, and subtracting that result advances both pointers by the original scaled value. All arithmetic agrees modulo 2^64, and no flags are preserved.

72f28650e5.why: The two live accumulators already fold every addition after their initial loads into an SSE2 memory operand.

97f115d344.why: Each channel needs both the original difference and its multiplied, shifted value, so the copies support required results and all four stores remain necessary.

ce40b1e167.why: Both pointer loads and additions are necessary, and the 32-bit shift must truncate and zero-extend before the separate 64-bit negation.

a0954268f6.why: The four distinct broadcasts feed four necessary multiply-adds, whose four sum and difference results are all preserved.

0034724f43.why: Both packed products and accumulator additions are required, the first product must remain in xmm0, and the index update supplies required flags.

1eaea5971b.why: The SSE2 reduction must also reproduce the complete final xmm0 value, including its dependence on the upper lanes retained by movhlps.

85a3a6d5b2.why: The doubling must wrap at 32 bits before zero-extension and 64-bit negation, while both pointer adjustments and the vector zero are required.

05b7d1ad55.rewrite:
vextracti128 xmm0,ymm1,0x1
vpaddd xmm1,xmm1,xmm0
vmovhlps xmm0,xmm0,xmm1
vpaddd xmm1,xmm1,xmm0
vpshuflw xmm0,xmm1,0xe
vpaddd xmm1,xmm1,xmm0
vmovd eax,xmm1
05b7d1ad55.why: The VEX-encoded vpshuflw already zeros the upper 128 bits of ymm0, the only preserved vector register. The final vzeroupper therefore changes only dead register state.

9215ea8605.why: SSE2 requires eight 128-bit stores at the specified addresses plus one instruction to establish the required zero vector.

0fdf22ed19.why: All eight stores use the maximum SSE2 vector width, and the final index update and its sign flag must be preserved.

f98183fa9e.why: The unknown indices require four separate stores, followed by independent pointer and counter updates with preserved flags.

61b458fd6e.why: The unknown row indices prevent combining the four stores, and both scalar updates and their required flags remain necessary.

820e72ce94.why: SSE2 needs the separate word shuffles and byte shifts, while folding the unaligned loads into legacy shuffle memory operands would introduce an alignment requirement.

ac4ddf232b.why: The scalar load, byte swap, store, two pointer updates, and flag-producing counter decrement are all required at this ISA level.

f3ab063b81.why: The arbitrary shuffle mask requires the load, shuffle, and store, and both updated pointers are preserved.

fce4fb7517.why: Each vector requires its own load, shuffle, and store, while the two pointer updates and counter decrement produce preserved results.

8be6380d33.why: The zero-extending qword load, arbitrary byte shuffle, store, and two pointer updates are all needed to preserve the full xmm0 result and memory.

b1ada119cb.why: The qword load, arbitrary byte shuffle, store, and two pointer updates are already minimal, and the VEX instructions establish the required zero upper half of ymm0.
